why: Operator, 2026-10-03, on the Medium review: sources often list a theatrical serial (chapter play) as one movie -- its chapters strung together -- even though it was never presented that way. A Series from the serial era (released by 1956) whose chapters are short (the Series record carries their length, at most 30 minutes) is a candidate for a Basic record: scored on the Basic profile, capped into Review, never auto-matched. Its class cannot be relied on: shaped on Medium row 34955 (Spy Smasher, 1942, a 12-chapter Republic serial registered as a Series classed ANTHOLOGY), where the reviewer picked the Series over an 81.3 Basic carried to the top by the source's wrong IMDb and Wikidata ids. Pins both halves: eligible (at or above the Review floor) and capped (never Accept). The short-series half of the same rule (a Series of at most 3 episodes) needs an episode count from the registry and is pinned by BMR-Review's tests/test_medium_rules_2026_10_03.py, not here.
